name: AskHemant 06 · Cal.com booking → Pipeline + WhatsApp confirmation and 2-hour reminder

nodes.name: Cal.com webhook
nodes.notes: Cal.com → Settings → Developer → Webhooks: this Production URL; triggers Booking created, Booking rescheduled, Booking cancelled; Secret = CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Config

assignments.name: event_labels
assignments.value: {"fit-call":"free 20-min Fit Call","ask-hemant-session":"45-min Ask Hemant Session","audit-workshop":"Lead Leak Audit workshop","kickoff":"kickoff call"}

nodes.notes: event_labels: Cal.com event slug → words used in the WhatsApp messages. stage_moving_events: slugs that move a lead to "Call booked".

nodes.name: Verify + normalise booking
nodes.notes: Checks X-Cal-Signature-256, then reads the booking, the attendee and the intake answers (matched by question label, so renaming identifiers is safe).

nodes.name: Match lead + build row
nodes.notes: Finds the lead by booking uid, WhatsApp or email. Moves the stage forward only (New/Replied → Call booked); a cancellation is flagged in booking_status, never moved backwards.

nodes.name: Decision
nodes.notes: Carries the decision past the Sheets / HTTP nodes, so the next nodes read plain $json.

nodes.name: WhatsApp: booking confirmation
nodes.notes: Utility template "ah_call_confirmation". The Cal.com booking form tells people they will get WhatsApp confirmations and reminders.

nodes.name: Wait until 2 h before
nodes.notes: Waiting executions are stored in the n8n database, so they survive restarts.

nodes.name: Still booked?
nodes.notes: Sends nothing if the booking was cancelled or moved while waiting (a reschedule starts its own wait).

nodes.name: WhatsApp: 2-hour reminder
nodes.notes: Utility template "ah_call_reminder_2h": "Reply 1 to confirm". Replies land in the WhatsApp Business app (coexistence) for Hemant to read.
